name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Contact Centre Scheduling for Claude Code: gaps, leave, rule checks and adherence, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Coverage gaps, next seven days
sections.note: Half hours where agents on the phone fall below the agents needed for the service level target. Gap is agents on the phone minus agents needed.
sections.sql: select queue, to_char(starts_at::date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, count(*)::int short_half_hours, min(gap) worst_gap, (array_agg(to_char(starts_at, 'HH24:MI') order by gap, starts_at))[1] worst_at, min(projected_sl_pct) lowest_projected_sl from wfm.coverage where gap < 0 and starts_at::date between current_date and current_date + 6 group by queue, starts_at::date order by starts_at::date, queue

sections.title: Leave waiting for a decision
sections.note: Newly short counts the half hours that would fall below requirement if the request is approved as the roster stands.
sections.sql: select code, name, queue, kind, starts_on, ends_on, current_date - requested_on days_waiting, newly_short, already_short from wfm.leave_impact order by newly_short desc, starts_on

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Each finding cites its rule in docs/compliance.md. A finding is a prompt to check, not legal advice.
sections.sql: select rule, shift, agent, work_date, detail from wfm.compliance_findings order by work_date, rule

sections.title: Adherence, last seven days
sections.sql: select agent, name, team, days, adherence_pct, worst_day_pct from wfm.adherence_week order by adherence_pct

sections.title: Forecast accuracy, last 28 days
sections.note: Daily volume against what the six week pattern would have predicted. MAPE is the average miss.
sections.sql: select queue, days, mape_pct, bias_pct, worst_day from wfm.forecast_accuracy order by queue

name: today
title: Today
subtitle: Actual against forecast so far, and the plan for the rest of the day

sections.title: Half hours so far
sections.sql: select q.code queue, to_char(i.starts_at, 'HH24:MI') as time, i.offered, round(c.calls)::int forecast, round(100.0 * i.answered_in_sl / nullif(i.offered, 0), 1) sl_pct, i.abandoned, i.aht_seconds aht, c.scheduled agents_on_phone from wfm.intervals i join wfm.queues q on q.id = i.queue_id left join wfm.coverage c on c.queue_id = i.queue_id and c.starts_at = i.starts_at where i.starts_at::date = current_date order by q.code, i.starts_at

sections.title: Rest of today on plan
sections.sql: select queue, to_char(starts_at, 'HH24:MI') as time, calls, required, scheduled, gap, projected_sl_pct from wfm.coverage c where starts_at::date = current_date and not exists (select 1 from wfm.intervals i where i.queue_id = c.queue_id and i.starts_at = c.starts_at) order by queue, starts_at

name: forecast
title: Forecast, next fourteen days
subtitle: Daily contacts and peak agents needed by queue

sections.title: By day
sections.sql: select queue, to_char(starts_at::date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, round(sum(calls))::int contacts, max(required) peak_agents_needed, round(sum(required) / 2.0, 1) agent_hours_needed, round(sum(scheduled) / 2.0, 1) agent_hours_on_phone from wfm.coverage group by queue, starts_at::date order by queue, starts_at::date

sections.title: Planner adjustments
sections.sql: select f.code, q.code queue, f.starts_at, f.ends_at, f.volume_pct, f.reason from wfm.forecast_adjustments f join wfm.queues q on q.id = f.queue_id order by f.starts_at

sections.title: History days far from pattern
sections.sql: select queue, day, offered, typical, variance_pct, excluded from wfm.history_outliers order by day
